notes.title: Pawn Simulator V.1.4.2 Released ! ( Shelf System / New Shelfs / New Decorations)
notes.content:
[h3]Hi Dealers ! First of all, we apologize for the delayed updates. Today's Update will completely change the way you play and you will have more beautiful and organized shops[/h3]

With this update, we added new shelves and decorations to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/ba912a7ca77b45aaf91a31e33486e2ce6856638e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/84c8f2b2619b20cfc5c4982fa97c3a45daa9428d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/88a1d0971cda0aa1cb47120edf1363f83039f66b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/ce070a4fcbcaafaf30bc5b2d4b74d770efe4dc34.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/eb40d5a085015993981c08aaff7b7efcfe510141.png[/img]


[h3]Here are the decorations and shelves for the newly added[/h3]

- New Wall Shelfs
- Guitar Hangers (Only for guitars)
- Animal Head Holders (Only For Animal Heads)
- TV Holder (Only For TV)
- Sword Holders (Only for Swords)

- Carpets
- New Paintings
- New Lights
- Clocks

[h3]Now let's consider the completely changed shelving system.[/h3]

Now, if an object is too large for a shelf, it will not fit on that shelf.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/0202693aa5eb7e5ce05eb097398fb6831c69de94.png[/img]

Now you should choose your shelves according to the size of the products. We think this update is really important, along with your feedbacks.

[h3]You need to buy special shelves to sell some special products[/h3]

Animal heads can now only be placed on animal head shelves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/88a1d0971cda0aa1cb47120edf1363f83039f66b.png[/img]

For your guitars, you need to buy guitar holders that can be placed on the floor or hung on the wall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/5ec124d8511fe3e78b89fe6884e9614465a28c30.png[/img]

A television shelf has now been added to the game for large televisions

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/ce6425b5af8856057fda24fa9f8b0403968b6106.png[/img]

For swords, you need to buy sword racks that can be hung on the wall or placed on the floor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/ce070a4fcbcaafaf30bc5b2d4b74d770efe4dc34.png[/img]

There are now small jewelry boxes inside the large horizontal shelves for jewelry, so you can put your jewelry in there too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/e4c0deb1bccd520c757a2e24808464a3c863dc4e.png[/img]

The ability to hang some products that were previously in the game on the wall has been removed, now if there is a special shelf for that product, you have to use it. Otherwise you cannot put these products on any shelf

As we said before, the purpose of this update is to increase the realism in the game and prevent unaesthetic things from occurring in the shop.

[h3]Apart from these, some improvements have been made, here are what were made[/h3]

- Hunger reduction rate reduced 
- The problem of not being able to enter the back of the L-shaped shelf has been resolved
- Made some improvements to increase optimization (We think you will get a certain level of fps increase)

We hope that we can increase your gaming pleasure with this update.

notes.title: Hunger Mechanic Released ! (V.1.3.01)
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Pawn Shop Owners. I hope you are fine. Hunger Mechanic was added to the game with today's Update. At the same time, some bugs were resolved and improvements were made.

We are very excited to release the Hunger Pack, the first pack in our roadmap.[/h3]

[b]Here is the content of Hunger Pack :[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/ebef000737bd0d36eeb8849850a353ab5f821780.jpg[/img]

You now have a hunger bar in the bottom left corner of the screen. Keeping your hunger level up gives you a speed advantage. If your hunger bar is completely depleted. you slow down

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/a50b7ed94949a915d692d06e860e351a77552d22.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/85c09aa0aa6fc7d588c61a2ec077b0f6ca1979aa.jpg[/img]

When you are hungry, you can go to a restaurant and eat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/8131c25a7b171a88bd631ff49141f40fab4dd6f7.jpg[/img]

To order a meal, if you approach the screen shown in the picture above and press the "E" key, a menu will open where you can choose your meal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/44adcf2041ef22391404b71524594fab172cb169.jpg[/img]

After you select and buy the meal, your meal will appear on the left, then if you look at the meal you ordered and press the "E" key, you will eat the meal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/ad741cc68444aea93df3f1ddbd41e8172c19665c.jpg[/img]


[b]Getting Drunk Mechanic :[/b]

Now we come to the most entertaining content of the package: Getting drunk !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/2b21f3bc7cbf03a97fa59e0c694f618b34a27745.jpg[/img]

All you have to do is go to the Casino, look at the bartender and press the "E" key. The bartender will prepare a drink for you

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/6fd35497549825b9f6b5db33044dfac5c255044f.jpg[/img]

After the bartender prepares it, you can drink the drink by looking at the glass that appears on the table and pressing the "E" key.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/ab818983e583d7df6313b937bad62ee354a9a6fa.jpg[/img]

Be careful not to drink too much (If you vomit while looking at the screen while playing the game, we are not responsible :D)

There are a few ways to get rid of this effect. First of all, if you sleep, this effect will disappear completely. If it is still time to sleep, you can choose to wait. This effect disappears within 3 minutes. If you are looking for a quick solution, you can buy and drink coffee from the Vending Machines added to different parts of the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/909c39f9851f3c1299269044bbf096ab354ebbb2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/4f8459efe0d82381529511f2772cd0a79d4ddde0.jpg[/img]

At the same time, if you are too far from a restaurant (you may be opening a warehouse or buying products from street vendors), you can buy snacks from vending machines that will satisfy your hunger to some extent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/4cf855537305775fc500f445620086fa72276523.jpg[/img]

[b]These were the new things added in today's update, here are the solved bugs.

- The black circular thing that appeared in the middle of the screen, which was more visible at night, has been removed
- Fixed UI issues with some resolutions
- The problem of Graphic Tablet not appearing during packaging when selling the product has been resolved.
- Removed the light stuck on the roof of the store
- The issue where the products you sold returned hanging in the air after saving has been resolved.
- Extra controls were added to eliminate the problem of not being able to put ribbons in the packages during packaging.
- Fixed the issue where Products and Packages were moving the Cashier Table 
- Added extra checks for Still Customer In The Shop Alert 
- The problem of overlapping customer dialogues on some computers has been resolved.[/b]

I hope we were able to increase your enjoyment of the game with this update. Have fun.

notes.title: Pawn Simulator V.2.0 Roadmap !
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Dealers. We are very excited to tell you about future plans in today's announcement. We work hard to make Pawn Simulator better every day. Today we will talk about future plans and the contents of Innovations.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/7794ab2f6a9346419606dfbf1571b76b13fdafe0.png[/img]

[b]Now we will go deeper into the Packages. 
Each package will be published separately over time. The packages will include improvements such as Keybinding, Controller Support, Multiple Save.[/b]

[b]Our first package is Hunger Pack. This package will be available in two days.[/b]

With the Hunger Pack, our character is now hungry. Keeping your hunger bar at high levels gives you speed advantages. If your hunger runs out completely, our character slows down.

The Burger Restaurant on the map has been activated and you will now be able to buy food there. There will also be food vending machines in different parts of the map. Instead of going to a restaurant every time you get hungry, you will be able to satisfy your hunger here.


Here are the new things that will come with the hunger pack :

 - Hunger bar added
 - The restaurant on the map has been activated
 - Added vending machines to different parts of the city
 - You can now interact with the bartender in the casino and drink
 - Added drunk mechanic if you drink too much (To get rid of this effect quickly, you need to sleep or buy coffee from vending machines. If you wait without doing these, the effect disappears over time.)


[b]Our second package is the Arrangement Pack.[/b]

With this package, the mechanics of placing products on the shelf will change completely. You will now need to place each product on the appropriate shelf for that product. At the same time, the option of placing suitable products on the floor will be added.

With this package, new shelf and decoration options will be added to the game.

Here are the new things that will come with the Arrangement Pack :

 - New Shelves
 - New Decorations
 - New Placing Product System

[b]Our third package is the Sales Pack.[/b]

With this package, new Employees that you can Hire will be added to the game.
Bodyguard for Thieves, sales specialist to negotiate for you, etc.

With this package, if you make customers wait too long in line, they will get bored and this will be reflected in your store's popularity score.

Here are the new things that will come with the Sales Pack :

 - New Staffs
 - New Customer Boring System

[b]Our Fourth Package is the Item Pack
[/b]
With this package, many new items will be added to the game.

You will be able to have more detailed information about your products with a statistics page that you can access from your tablet. 

You will be able to set discount days in your store at any time, and all your product prices will be cheaper by the discount amount you set, thus increasing the number of customers coming to your store.

Here are the new things that will come with the Item Pack :

 - New Items
 - New Item Statistic System
 - Discount Days

[b]Our Fifth Package is the City Pack
[/b]
In this package, we will focus entirely on the city. Driving mechanics will change completely and a car buying mechanic will come to the game.

A gas system will be added for your car. When you run out of gas, you will have to go to the gas station and fill it up.

The city will become more vibrant

A new store will be added to the game where you can buy items forgotten by people.

Stores selling different products that you can buy wholesale will be added (This time you will be the one trying to reduce the price when purchasing these products).

[b]These are our current future plans. I hope we can further increase your enjoyment of the game with these updates. Don't forget to share your suggestions with us. Have fun![/b]

notes.title: V.1.2.1 Released ! (Music Player)
notes.content:
[h3]Hi Dealers. With this update, a [b]Music Player[/b] has been added to the game, now you can play the music you want in your store.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/13aa09d3c81ed14c88c1381affddf5a9160a243d.png[/img]

First, you must buy the Music Player from the store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/02d27416e97dc89c91283f08d427d49bd4dc283a.png[/img]

By default, there are 5 songs in it. But if you want, you can add your own music to the game. All you have to do is. Send music files to this path:

[b]Documents/Editmode Studio/Music[/b]

Enter and exit the game once for this path to be created automatically. If you don't want to do this you can create it yourself

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/cd15648e66d52d3d4167c99281c1565f147ba522.png[/img]

[b](The songs in the picture are not in the game, they are just examples.)[/b]

We hope this update increases your enjoyment of the game.

-  Fixed the issue of products getting stuck on the floor in the back room of the store.

notes.title: V.1.2 Released With Steam Cloud !
notes.content:
[b][h2]Hello dealers. Thank you for your support and Patience so far.[/h2][/b]

[h3]With this version, many problems have been solved and new things have been added. Here are the contents of the update :[/h3]


- Steam Cloud added.

- The problem of teleporting into the warehouse when you approach the warehouse with a car and exit the car has been resolved. Now if there is something on your left, you exit through the right door.

- The issue of cashiers not leaving the store at night has been resolved

-Fixed some translation problems with product names

- The problem of customers going to only one cashier despite having two cashiers in the store has been resolved. Now customers go to two cashiers randomly

- The Truck position reset button in the ESC menu no longer works when there are products behind the truck. If you want to reset you need to unload the products

- A new button has been added to the ESC menu. The purpose of this button is to flip the truck.

- Now the products in the warehouse are only visible when you open the warehouse. No more products randomly appearing around warehouses

- Now a notification appears when the paint on the paintroller runs out. And at the same time, if there is no paint in the paintroller, the outlines of the paintable walls do not open.

- Customers now spawn more trash

- The spawning of a garbage bag when you switch to another item (such as Hammer) while collecting garbage has been removed. A new trash bag now spawns after collecting 10 trash items

- Some translation issues resolved

- All objects that can be hung on the wall have been reworked. Now all the objects you think can be hung on the wall can be hung on the wall.

- Fixed an issue where the item would be positioned incorrectly when customers bring in the "Shield" item

- The size of the "Ring" product has been reduced

- Fumes from garbage have been reduced

- The issue where the labels on the street vendors' tables were too bright at night has been resolved

- The issue of the repair UI appearing when you look at a garbage bag or anything other than an item while holding the Hammer product has been resolved.
The repair UI now appears only when you look at something that can be repaired

- Now tickets can only be placed on products.

notes.title: We are sorry for the bugs experienced during the launch of the game.
notes.content:
Hi Guys. We are writing this post to express our regret for the bugs and disruptions experienced in the release.

We have released 4 updates since the game was released and we will continue to work to make the game better every day.

Thank you very much for your interest and feedback so far. I hope we have been able to further increase your enjoyment of the game with these updates.

Here are the things solved and added today:


[b]- Fixed the issue where the day seen on the calendar was different from the day seen on the tablet.
- Fixed the issue of not being able to move when you want to leave after participating in the warehouse auction
- Fixed the issue where skill descriptions did not appear after a certain period of time.
- Fixed the issue where the black screen that appears when you want to examine the product you have received does not fully cover the screen.
-An icon has been added to see the location of the player on the map.
- The problem of it being dark even though it is morning has been Fixed
- Fixed the issue where people got stuck at the entrance of the shop
- Fixed the problem of the robot vacuum cleaner coming out
-The problem of the police entering the store and waiting has been Fixed
- Added 1600 x 900 Resolution
- Added Mouse Sensitivity
- Fixed the issue where the remaining items in the box were deleted after saving and re-entering the game.
-Fixed the issue where the cursor remained open when switching from tablet to hand
- Fixed the issue where NPCs walking on the street were walking through buildings
- The problem of changing warehouse prices when saving the game and entering it again has been Fixed.
- Fixed the issue where warehouse stars did not appear correctly after saving the game
- Reduced the rate at which customers bring expensive items at the beginning of the game[/b]

notes.title: What's News on RELEASE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/2c58786cf30003fa81a83ddfaecf206ed5791e08.png[/img]

[h2]- Storage Wars[/h2]
    . Immerse yourself in the famous television show. Enter the auction! Join a fierce battle! Find and sell profitable products!

[h2]- New City[/h2]
    . A vast city for you to explore.

[h2]- Car[/h2]
    . It's easier to explore the new city by car!

[h2]- Bank[/h2]
    . Take out a loan! Be careful because if you don't make your payments on time, you may go bankrupt!

[h2]- Smuggler[/h2]
    . The smuggler can find the most suitable products for you! But be careful, the police may fine those who sell illegal products!

[h2]- Casino Models Update[/h2]
    . Casino is now more lively!

[h2]- New Casino Games[/h2]
    . Blackjack: Look at the cards in your hand, keep them according to the table or try your luck!
    . Roulette: Choose your lucky number and wait! Maybe luck will smile on you too!

[h2]- Street Seller[/h2]
    . The goods left by neighbors in the city can also be beautiful! Don't miss it!

[h2]- Police[/h2]
    - From now on, the police will come to inspect from time to time! If you're not selling contraband, you have nothing to fear. If you're selling illegal products, you should smell it!

notes.content:
[h2]What's New Added?[/h2]

- Restaurant added, human interaction and hunger mechanics coming soon.
- Bank added, credit system coming soon.

[/h2]
[h3]- The human population is more stable and organized.
- Sound fixes for Shift key acceleration.
- Interaction key "E" becomes available with "Z" for general use.
- Fixed some absurd situations caused by inverted object interactions.
- Thief mechanics have been made more stable.
- Some dialog fixes.
- Some sound balancing.
- Fixed the popularity system decrease issue.
- Fixed some bugs when switching between tablet menus.[/h3]
